abstract: A Workday-commissioned study examining the actual business value of AI implementations reveals significant inefficiencies in AI deployment. While organizations capture time savings from AI tools, nearly 40% of these gains are negated by rework activities such as error correction and output verification, with only 14% of employees experiencing consistent positive net outcomes from AI use.
keyFindings: Nearly 40% of AI time savings are lost to rework, including correcting errors, rewriting content, and verifying outputs from one-size-fits-all AI tools.
Only 14% of employees consistently get clear, positive net outcomes from AI.
methodology: Not specified in provided excerpt. Study conducted by Workday in collaboration with Hanover Research; full methodology details not available in source material provided.
